title: Listening Drill — Drawing a floor plan — Guided practice
description: Practical demonstration. One synthetic recording, six questions. Recommended time: 7 minutes.

sections.title: Drawing a floor plan — Guided practice
sections.transcript:
TUTOR: Before our demonstration on drawing a floor plan, let me explain what you need and what to record. Collect your materials from the design suite before the demonstration begins. Inside the handout you will find a blank floor sketch to fill in.

TUTOR: Watch the demonstration once before you try it. Before you begin, check for the fault that affected the previous group: damaged tape. If you notice it, let me know instead of making an adjustment yourself.

TUTOR: Now work in pairs. After the first attempt, check wall length and write the result down immediately. You then have forty minutes to compare your result with your partner’s. You can disagree, but both partners should keep a note of what they observed.

TUTOR: On your way out, take anything you borrowed back to the building desk. Please leave your notes in the folder so we can discuss them next time.
